section_summary.extract_value: This abstract describes a study that developed and investigated a model of positive body image, focusing on body appreciation as a mediator. The study involved 249 college women and found that interpersonal and intrapersonal variables predicted body appreciation, which in turn predicted intuitive eating. Body appreciation was confirmed as a mediator in the model.
